READING
Recall for catalysts with NO other reaction is 0.158 at k=100. This is the structural limit,
not a failure: the gene is not in the vocabulary, so no score over that vocabulary can name it.
37% of all catalysts sit in that position. The method expands the scope of enzymes we already
know; it does not nominate a protein that has never been annotated as catalysing anything.
Temporal holdout is 0.145 WORSE than random at k=20. The headline number benefited from
knowing the future; a prospective run would do worse than the retrospective one suggests.
